root_cause: A recent host firewall rules update (CHG-4490) denies egress from order-gateway to reference-db on port 5432, causing the order-gateway to fail requests with high error rate (HTTP 503).
summary: Escalated to on-call: Investigator found the root cause (firewall rule blocking order-gateway's access to reference-db) and no immediate fix in runbook; reviewer had no action to approve. Escalation is needed to rollback CHG-4490 or work on configuration fix to restore connectivity.
